nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Why has the thermal conversion of woody biomass gained prominence?
nodes.answer: It facilitates the disposal of wood waste and generates bioash rich in mineral content, which can be reused for soil amendment.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Reneawable energy adoption|Biomass energy utilization_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What are some advantages of employing brown rot, white rot, and soft rot fungi for the degradation of lignocellulosic complex?
nodes.answer: Brown rot, white rot, and soft rot fungi generate a low quantity of by-products and involve low energy consumption.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Reneawable energy adoption|Biomass energy utilization_qna_002
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How can distribute processes for biomass conversion, as discussed by Osasco et al., contribute to achieving the UN Sustainable Development Goals?
nodes.answer: Distributed processes for biomass conversion, as discussed by Osasco et al., can aid in achieving the UN Sustainable Development Goals by providing renewable energy sources and promoting sustainable practices.
